# v1.21.4 — Connection, dispatch and diagnostics

## Coming from v1.21.3

- **Connection and maintenance:** Reconfigure the inverter address, port or slave ID in place. The selected AC limit is saved per inverter, and clock sync uses packed BCD in the Home Assistant time zone. New Restart PCS, Restart EMS and Reset Energy Totals entities default to disabled.
- **Raw register actions:** The public raw-write action targets one inverter and accepts a documented list of operational addresses. Specify the configuration entry when several inverters are loaded. Existing named inverter controls retain their dedicated write paths.
- **Dispatch:** Hold preferences survive restarts and reloads. Dispatch itself still needs a fresh start. Force Export and Force Import now accumulate small grid corrections, coalesce power edits and preserve the original deadline when changing power or cutoff. An optional **Excess Export Duration** and countdown give Excess Export a timed stop. Its default of zero leaves timed stopping disabled.
- **Polling and house load:** Rejected Modbus blocks are split to recover valid neighbouring readings. Repeated unsupported responses are retried every ten minutes. Normal communication failures still surface. UPS house load uses PV and battery power when the grid reading is near zero.
- **Diagnostics:** Battery Power and Current descriptions now show positive for discharge and negative for charge. Battery Status includes charge/discharge flags. The readable Work Mode and opt-in Hillview System Mode report operating status and configured coupling respectively. New BMS and PV energy diagnostics are opt-in. The house-load comparisons from b2 remain available as disabled-by-default diagnostic estimates.
- **Energy history:** Existing PV counters keep their register mappings and entity IDs. The separate optional `0x0092` counter is available for checking AC-coupled production. Your current Energy dashboard sources and daily house-load accumulator can continue to use their existing readings.

The release was validated with automated Home Assistant, simulated inverter, dashboard and packaging checks. The new control changes were not exercised on physical hardware as part of this release.
